## RETRAUCI cohorts with the same study periods

```{r}
retrauci_df <- read.csv2(
  "C:/Users/user/OneDrive - udl.cat/Desktop/RETRASCORE_VALIDATION/retrauci.csv",
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

retrauci_df$fecha_trauma <- as.Date(
  retrauci_df$fecha_trauma,
  format = "%d/%m/%Y"
)
retrauci_df$anio_trauma <- as.integer(format(
  retrauci_df$fecha_trauma,
  "%Y"
))

# Same years as DESARROLLO: 2015-2017
retrauci_desarrollo_df <- retrauci_df[
  retrauci_df$anio_trauma %in% 2015:2017,
]

# Same years as VALIDACION: 2018-2019
retrauci_validacion_df <- retrauci_df[
  retrauci_df$anio_trauma %in% 2018:2019,
]

retrauci_desarrollo_df
retrauci_validacion_df
```

## Rows with one or more missing values

```{r}
rows_with_na <- data.frame(
  dataset = c("DESARROLLO", "VALIDACION"),
  total_rows = c(nrow(desarrollo_df), nrow(validacion_df)),
  rows_with_one_or_more_na = c(
    sum(rowSums(is.na(desarrollo_df)) >= 1),
    sum(rowSums(is.na(validacion_df)) >= 1)
  )
)

rows_with_na
```
